description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of error types, comparing “All Changes” to “All Errors”. The chart contains six slices representing different error categories: PW, R, RW, N, NW, and a category simply labeled “W”. A legend is present, associating the labels with corresponding colors – light green for PW, light blue for R, yellow for RW, dark blue for N, purple for NW, and gray for W. In the “All Changes” chart, the slices represent approximately 50% for W, 26% for PW, 4% for R, 14% for RW, 1% for N, and 5% for NW. The “All Errors” chart shows approximately 56% for W, 29% for PW, 3% for R, 6% for RW, 1% for N, and 5% for NW. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice. The slices in both charts appear to be ordered from largest to smallest based on their proportional size.
